_comment: Production parameter file for redeploys backed by an Azure Key Vault. Live KV (created 2026-05-06): cortexks-kv in cortex-rg / centralus. Container App's system-assigned managed identity has the 'Key Vault Secrets User' role on this vault. Two secrets are stored: cortex-database-url (full asyncpg connection string) and cortex-jwt-secret-key. To use this file, copy it over parameters.json and run deploy.sh without the DB_ADMIN_PASSWORD/JWT_SECRET_KEY env vars (Bicep will resolve them from KV at deploy time).
